ADX at 29.4 shows trend formation, but -DI (26.8) is stronger than +DI (14.9), indicating downward pressure. Weekly ADX at 17.9 suggests no trend, risking confusion with short-term daily pullbacks. 4H RSI at 32.6 also in oversold, mirroring daily. Five consecutive daily closes including -7.26% suggest further downside. Consider buying after RSI confirms below 30 or recovers above 50.
